q: What are the emissions from heat treating wooden export crates?
title: Heat treated export crate emissions
short: ISPM 15 heat treatment holds the wood core at a set temperature for a set time, usually in a chamber heated by a wood waste or diesel boiler. Count fossil fuel in Scope 1, report wood fuel CO2 separately as biogenic, and add sawn timber per crate.
audience: Packaging makers and exporters using wooden crates

ul: Crates or cubic metres treated per batch.

p: Plywood or plastic pallets do not need treatment. Compare whole footprints, not only the treatment step.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
